Initial release of media-crawler skill.

- Supports multi-platform open data crawling (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Tieba, Zhihu)
- Features keyword search, post/comment retrieval, login cache, proxy, and WebUI
- Allows output in CSV, JSON, JSONL, Excel, SQLite, MySQL
- Includes command-line usage and configuration instructions
- Emphasizes legal/compliance requirements for usage
